# Float Curve

Remaps values through a smooth editable curve.

`lfs.float_curve` · Utilities

## How to use

Edit the control points to shape the mapping.\
Fritsch–Carlson interpolation avoids overshoot between monotone points.

## Inputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Value | `Value` | lfs.float | 0 | step 0.01; accepts per-element values | Value field to remap through the curve. |
